description.value: Steamworks is a landmark Gastown brew pub operating since 1995, credited as the first urban brew pub in Canada, spread across 8,191 square feet on two floors overlooking Vancouver Harbour. The steam-powered brewery pours 20 rotating taps — including year-round core beers, seasonals, and Brew Pub exclusives — best sampled through their signature 10 Tap Taster Paddle. Heated and covered patios, a full food menu ranging from pub classics to plant-based dishes, and a heritage Gastown location just off the Seaside Greenway make it a natural destination stop for touring cyclists.
